[[File:MaksimenkoSA.jpg|thumb|Maksimenko in 2018]]
'''Sergey Afanasievich Maksimenko''' ({{langx|ru|Сергей Афанасьевич Максименко}}; 13 August 1954 – 16 March 2026) was a Belarusian physicist.<ref>{{Cite web |author1=Massimo Nicolazzo |author2=Edmondo Colella |author3=Antonio Maffucci |title=FANEM |url=http://www.fanem.org/?who=committees |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200628054038/http://www.fanem.org/?who=committees |archive-date=28 June 2020 |access-date=14 April 2026 |website=FANEM}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Maksimenko was born in [[Kryvichy, Myadzyel district|Krivichi]] on 13 August 1954. In 1976, he graduated from the Faculty of Physics of the [[Belarusian State University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Поздравляем! Доктор физико-математических наук Сергей Максименко первым из белорусских ученых удостоен звания почетного члена SPIE (SPIE Fellow) |url=https://bsu.by/news/43813-d/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210819201902/https://bsu.by/news/43813-d/ |archive-date=19 August 2021 |access-date=14 April 2026 |website=BSU |language=ru}}</ref> 

From 2004 to 2008, and again from 2013 to 2026, he was a member of the General Meeting of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Belarus]]. From 2008 to 2019, he was a member of the Expert Council of the [[Higher Attestation Commission]] of the Republic of Belarus. He was awarded the Certificate of Honor of the Higher Attestation Commission of the Republic of Belarus (2019).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Академия Google |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=NDCVRhwAAAAJ&hl=ru&oi=ao |access-date=14 April 2026 |website=Google Scholar}}</ref>
 
Maksimenko died on 16 March 2026, at the age of 72.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sergey Afanasievich Maksimenko 13.08.1954 - 16.03.2026 |url=https://inp.bsu.by/index.php/ru/institut-ru/novosti/494-sergej-afanasevic-maksimenko-13-08-1954-16-03-2026 |work=BSU}}</ref>
 
==Awards==
* 2010: Honorary title "Honored Worker of BSU".<ref>{{Cite web |title=Первыми обладателями почетного звания «Заслуженный работник БГУ» стали 58 преподавателей и сотрудников вуза |url=https://bsu.by/news/88363-d/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210917012913/https://bsu.by/news/88363-d/ |archive-date=17 September 2021 |access-date=14 April 2026 |website=bsu.by |language=ru}}</ref>
* 2020: [[Francysk Skaryna Medal]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Decree of the President of the Republic of Belarus dated 8 January 2020 № 7 "On awarding". |url=https://pravo.by/upload/docs/op/P32000007_1578690000.pdf}}</ref>
* 2025: {{interlanguage link|Honoured Scientist of the Republic of Belarus|be|Заслужаны дзеяч навукі Рэспублікі Беларусь}}.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Указ № 299 ад 7 жніўня 2025 г. Аб узнагароджанні {{!}} Официальный интернет-портал Президента Республики Беларусь |url=https://president.gov.by/ru/documents/ukaz-no-299-ad-7-zniuna-2025-g |access-date=14 April 2026 |website=president.gov.by |language=ru}}</ref>
